data.notes: Most Seoul underground club calendars and ticketing platforms have not yet published April 2027 listings; the only verified scene-fit event found is a salsa x street dance festival with late-night socials and hip-hop/street-dance crossover programming.

events.title: SIDF 2027 Seoul International Dance Festival — Salsa X Street / THE SAUCE
events.summary: Three-day Seoul dance-scene gathering built around workshops, shows, all-night socials until 6 a.m., and THE SAUCE salsa x freestyle/street 1v1 battle, with programs open to street, Latin and all-style dancers.

events.title: Seoul International Dance Festival (SIDF) 2027
events.summary: A Seoul salsa/Latin dance festival with workshops, shows, live-band nights and social rooms running across three days at Cube Convention Center. The official site says one pass covers the April 23–25 program and lists confirmed participating artists/instructors as the lineup continues to grow.
